hook: If you stood on Mars, Mount Everest would look small.
title: On Mars, Everest Would Look Small
description:
Olympus Mons on Mars is about 22 km high, roughly two and a half times Everest's height above sea level. It is the tallest known volcano in our solar system. Everest would look small next to it.

#Shorts #Space #Mars
